name: Freedom-class littoral combat ship (LCS-1 type), US Navy, as in service 2020-2025

published.source: US Navy fact graphic 'An informational graphic depicting the littoral combat ship USS Freedom' (Commons 8618564659): 378 ft by 57.4 ft; warship_specs.js 'LCS (Freedom class)' 115.3 x 17.5 m

must_show: a steel semi-planing monohull 115.5 m long, stem head at x +57.65, a 45 deg raked stem from the forefoot at x +51.1, a flat transom at x -57.65 with four waterjets [Navy graphic; LCS-9 2020]
the long forecastle with the Mk 110 57 mm (the trained 'turret' node) at its after end, ring at x +30.75, z 5.86 [Navy graphic; LCS-21 2025]

the house rising sheer from the deck edge (no side deck), its sides leaning in 13.5 deg from the deck edge (half-breadth 8.72) to the 01 roof at z 11.4 (half-width 7.3), from the hangar's after face at x -27.9 to the foot of the sloping front at x +27 [Navy graphic; LCS-1 2013]
the bridge glazing round the front of the 02 level at z 14.0 .. 15.4, and four white radomes on the roofs [LCS-9 2020; LCS-5 2022]
the faceted tower mast x +2.4 .. +10.4 at its foot, head at z 20.6 with the box air-search array, the yard at z 21.0 and the pole to z 31.1 [LCS-9 2020; LCS-21 2025]
the Mk 46 30 mm mounts on sponsons either side abaft the bridge at x +14.7, y +-8.05 [LCS-5 2022]
the RAM Mk 49 launcher on the hangar roof at x -23.4, z 11.4 [Navy graphic]
a flat fenced flight deck at z 5.6 from the hangar face (x -27.9) to the stern, a landing circle in the team colour; plain haze grey, no hull number [LCS-9; LCS-21]
